title: Project
description: A scope boundary. Tasks live in projects. Projects can be auto-detected from a repo's git root, but the protocol does not mandate any specific detection strategy.

slug.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier. Lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens; cannot start or end with hyphen.

repo_path.description: Canonical local path of the repo root, used for auto-detect (e.g. via 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel'). Optional — projects may exist without a repo.
